content: The recommended doses of CEDAX Oral Suspension are outlined below. It is essential to administer CEDAX Oral Suspension at least 2 hours before or 1 hour after a meal. Pediatric patients weighing more than 45 kg should receive the maximum daily dose of 400 mg. For patients with renal impairment, CEDAX Capsules and CEDAX Oral Suspension can be administered at standard doses if the creatinine clearance is 50 mL/min or greater. Specific dosing recommendations for patients with varying degrees of renal insufficiency are provided in the following guidelines. In patients undergoing hemodialysis two or three times per week, a single 400-mg dose of cefditoren capsules or a single dose of 9 mg/kg (with a maximum of 400 mg) of cefditoren oral suspension should be administered at the conclusion of each hemodialysis session. For mixing CEDAX Oral Suspension, once prepared, the suspension can be stored for up to 14 days in a refrigerator. Ensure the container is tightly closed. Shake the suspension well before each use. Discard any unused portion after 14 days.
